acceptanceCriteria: A spec records the owner's intent verbatim, numbered requirements per stage (page objects, step IR, data setup, navigation edges, inferred flows, task model, generator, proof pipeline), non-goals, failure modes (never invent a step, locator or setup; abstain with named gaps), acceptance evidence including a real-adopter qualification, and rollback.
It reuses and cites the existing contracts (AMAP-V0, ANL-V0, AFU-V1, DCP-V1, AMSP-V0, CCE-V0, NEA-V0, RVN-V0, PWP, TSA-V0) instead of duplicating them, naming each extension point.
The spec defines 'confidently' as: the generated test ran live against the target app at a pinned revision, passed TSA validity and negative controls, and every step traces to learned evidence.

Target adopter and router dialect are chosen before stage 1: AMAP resolves only ui-router, rails-routes and react-router literals (JSX <Routes> gives 0 screens, V1-1712; 0 screens on actualbudget); either pick a target whose router AMAP resolves or make the missing dialect a prerequisite ticket.

Preregistered measure: N owner-written 'how do I X' requests with a kill threshold (proposed: under 40% answered with a passing, discriminating test kills the approach); report answered vs abstained, unanchored statements = 0, and byte-identical reruns.
Constraints recorded: browser and Node stay in companions (invariant 7); lexical matching only, no embeddings; learned steps/flows are proposals until a human accepts them.
body: Owner goal (2026-10-19): from an app's existing tests, learn every page object, link/navigation, data setup and the step sequences that do anything in the site; then 'show me how to do X' builds an e2e test that demonstrates X, proven by a live run, or abstains naming what is missing. Inventory at origin/main 6ceee260b: appmap screens/page-object bindings (AMAP-V0), navigation ledger (ANL-V0), flows (AFU-V1), legacy discovery/crosswalk (DCP-V1-060..069), test-knowledge (DCP-V1-086..092, PR #1165), AMSP draft planner, CCE compile/prove (partly unbuilt), NEA/RVN/PWP/TSA validation pieces exist but are not chained. This ticket records the human-owned intent and the staged contract (docs/specs/site-knowledge-howto-v0.md) that the extractor, model, generator and proof tickets build on.
title: Site knowledge from tests -> 'show me how to do X' e2e generation: owner intent spec and staged plan
